note: Gameplay progression proposal for regions 1 to 10. Design data only; no game code changed. V2.2: 8 elements (Frost = Water/Ice, Storm = Lightning), affinity chart, 12 weakness hits, column merges, 5 families; every sub-area has an elite with footprint; bosses carry footprint and bossRow.

levelRule.elite: Greenvale: ordinary max; from region 2: bossLv
levelRule.extension: Regions 3 to 10 add five boss levels each (16 to 55), sub-area boss levels non-decreasing with repeats. Enemy HP and ATK use the V2.1 stat rule (WORLD_PROGRESSION section 4.1); rewards w(L) past Lv20 are an open decision.
levelRule.statRule: L<=15: HP 2.2+0.95L, ATK 1.5+0.42L. L>15: HP 16.5+0.5(L-15), ATK 7.8+0.12(L-15). Elite x1.6 HP, boss x2.1 HP; Big bodies use the footprint table.

1.elements: Wood, Water, Earth, Wind pips; Lightning pips at the Highlands
1.affinity: Affinity arrows on enemy cards (weak x1.5, resist x0.5); Wildfire (Oak Wood), Sap (Mirror Lake), Bloom merge (Mirror Lake, the column rule) = 3

1.rend: First Fangs unit in the first reward; Rend on Piggyback; Bulwark (Ruins) stops Rend and Pierce

regions.name: The Necropolis of Twelve Hours
regions.structureNote: Vertical descent. Twelve hours of night, one sub-area each, down a stair of gates. Egyptian Duat, Mesopotamian Irkalla, Greek Hades, Norse Helheim, Maya Xibalba, Korean afterlife and Welsh Annwn share one city. Cold fire and river light; each gate is a tollgate.
regions.terrain: A vast underworld temple-city, descended hour by hour: gate, causeway, rivers, halls of judgement, houses of trial, seven gates, bridge, furnace, throne
teaches: Light and Shadow pips at depth; Eclipse
Every weakness hit and merge once more in a single hour; optional single weakness removed on bosses (open decision)
Ward and Rebirth to survive the end
Full builds: Legendary hubs, stage 3, Rend caps

elements: Light/Shadow mastery (Huma, Raven Pair, Cat Sidhe)
unlocks.nudge: Legendary hubs; a three-element column for three merges; Rebirth and Ward to survive the deepest bosses
